help.title: About Chats
help.intro: Chats is a viewer for the Claude Code and Codex sessions that live on your host. You run the AI in your terminal — the app reads the transcript files it writes.
help.step.local.title: Reads transcripts on your host
help.step.local.body: Claude Code and Codex save every session as a JSONL file on disk (e.g. ~/.claude/projects/…). PocketShell reads those files through your paired host and lists them here.
help.step.privacy.title: Your chats stay on your machine
help.step.privacy.body: Conversations and AI processing never touch PocketShell's servers. The transcript stream is end-to-end between your phone and your host — we just relay encrypted bytes if your network needs it.
help.step.run.title: Run the agent in a terminal
help.step.run.body: To start or continue a chat, open a terminal on the host and run claude or codex. The session appears in this list as soon as the CLI writes its first line.
help.step.resume.title: Tap any chat to open it
help.step.resume.body: Tap a row to read the transcript, or long-press for actions like Resume in terminal — which picks the conversation back up on the host.
help.footnote: Tap the help icon in the header anytime to see this again.
